prompt: Create an ultra-realistic vertical smartphone selfie portrait of a young woman in a cozy bedroom, photographed at close range with natural window light. The subject is a young woman in her early 20s with dark brown hair styled in a messy high bun with loose face-framing strands and flyaway hairs, thick natural eyebrows, brown eyes, long lashes, clear dewy skin with subtle pores and a few small blemishes, and soft neutral pink lips. She looks directly into the camera with a calm, slightly intimate expression while her right hand is raised over her mouth as if blowing a kiss; visible natural nails and a thin gold ring on the ring finger. She wears a ribbed dark brown scoop-neck henley tank top with small buttons and scalloped trim. Compose the image as a tight head-and-shoulders portrait, face filling most of the frame, slightly tilted angle, cropped from upper chest to above the bun, with shallow depth of field. Background: softly blurred bedroom interior with warm beige walls, a bedside lamp glowing on the left, a small green plant, a framed wall print reading Good Things Take Time, a bed edge, and a white door with a dark handle on the right. Lighting should be soft and flattering, realistic skin texture, no heavy makeup, no airbrushed plastic look. Use natural colors, high detail, candid Pinterest-style realism, as if captured on a modern phone camera, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.

promptZh: 创作一张年轻女性在舒适卧室中的超写实智能手机竖构图自拍人像，采用近距离拍摄，并利用自然窗光。主体为 一位 20 出头的年轻女性，留着 深棕色头发，发型为凌乱的高丸子头，脸颊两侧有散落的发丝和碎发，拥有浓密的天然眉毛、棕色眼睛、长睫毛，清透水润的皮肤上带有细微毛孔和少量瑕疵，嘴唇为柔和的中性粉色。她直视镜头，表情平静且略带亲昵，右手抬起放在嘴边，仿佛在送飞吻；可见自然的指甲和无名指上的一枚细金戒指。她身穿 一件深棕色罗纹圆领亨利衫，带有小纽扣和扇形饰边。构图为紧凑的头部和肩部人像，脸部占据画面大部分空间，角度略微倾斜，从上胸部到丸子头上方进行裁剪，具有浅景深效果。背景：柔焦的卧室室内，墙壁为暖米色，左侧有一盏发光的床头灯，一株小绿植，一幅墙面装饰画，上面写着 Good Things Take Time，以及床沿和右侧带有深色把手的白色门。光线应柔和且修饰肤色，呈现真实的皮肤质感，无厚重妆容，无磨皮塑料感。使用自然色彩，高细节，呈现 Pinterest 风格的写实感，如同现代手机拍摄，比例为 9:16 竖屏。
